sources: SAGE Dataset (tirtho149/SAGE) - 839K images, 335 crops, 1,251 disease classes
CDDMBench (UnicomAI/UnicomBenchmark) - Crop Disease Diagnosis Multimodal Benchmark
ICAR (Indian Council of Agricultural Research) guidelines for Indian crop diseases

rice.importance: Primary staple crop of India — highest priority

diseases.name: Rice Blast
symptoms: Diamond-shaped or eye-shaped lesions on leaves with gray/white center
Brown to reddish-brown border around lesions
Lesions on neck of panicle causing 'neck rot'
White or gray cottony growth in humid conditions
Affected panicle turns whitish-gray (called 'dead heart')
diseases.favorable_conditions: Cool nights (20-25°C), warm days, high humidity, heavy dew

diseases.name: Brown Plant Hopper
symptoms: Circular patches of yellowing and drying of plants (hopperburn)
Plants dry up suddenly like scorching
Insects found at base of plant near waterline
Honeydew secretion causing sooty mold

diseases.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight
symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaf margins turning yellowish
Lesions expand and turn white or straw-colored
Leaf edges wilt and dry
In severe cases entire leaves dry up
Yellow sticky droplets (bacterial ooze) on lesions in morning
treatments: Remove and burn severely infected plants

diseases.name: Sheath Blight
symptoms: Oval or irregular lesions on sheath near waterline
Lesions have whitish center with brown border
Lesions coalesce and extend upward to upper sheaths and leaves
White cottony mycelium seen under humid conditions

diseases.name: Healthy
symptoms: Green leaves with no lesions
Normal plant height and color

wheat.importance: Second most important staple crop in India

diseases.name: Wheat Yellow Rust
symptoms: Yellow-orange pustules arranged in stripes along leaf veins
Pustules turn dark brown later in season
Leaves turn yellow and die prematurely
White cottony growth visible in early stages
prevention: Early sowing before peak rust season

diseases.name: Wheat Brown Rust
symptoms: Small round to oval orange-red pustules scattered randomly on leaves
Pustules do not form stripes (unlike yellow rust)
Leaves turn yellow around pustules
Black teliospores visible in late season

diseases.name: Wheat Powdery Mildew
symptoms: White powdery patches on upper leaf surface
Patches enlarge and turn gray-brown
Affected leaves turn yellow and die
Powdery coating on stems and spikes in severe cases

diseases.name: Healthy
symptoms: Green leaves with no disease signs
Erect healthy plants

tomato.importance: Most important vegetable crop in India

diseases.name: Tomato Early Blight
symptoms: Dark brown to black spots with concentric rings (target-board pattern)
Yellow halo around spots
Lower and older leaves affected first
Spots enlarge and coalesce causing leaf death
Stem lesions at soil level (collar rot)
prevention: Drip irrigation to avoid wetting foliage

diseases.name: Tomato Late Blight
symptoms: Water-soaked oily spots on leaves
White mold on undersurface of leaves in humid conditions
Spots turn brown and papery
Brown to dark brown rotting of stems
Greenish-brown firm rot on fruits
prevention: Fungicide spray at first sign of disease

diseases.name: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus
diseases.pathogen: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV) — transmitted by whitefly
symptoms: Upward or downward curling of leaves
Leaves become leathery and thick
Plants become stunted and bushy
Yellowing of leaf margins
Severe reduction in fruit set
treatments: Control whitefly vector with Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.3 ml/liter
No chemical cure for virus — remove infected plants
prevention: Nylon net nursery to prevent whitefly

diseases.name: Tomato Septoria Leaf Spot
symptoms: Small circular spots with dark brown border and gray center
Tiny black dots (pycnidia) visible in center of spots
Lower leaves affected first
Severe defoliation in wet conditions

diseases.name: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus
symptoms: Yellowing and upward curling of young leaves
Leaf margins curl upward and inward
Stunted plant growth
Flower drop and poor fruit setting
treatments: Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.3 ml/liter for whitefly control

diseases.name: Healthy
symptoms: Dark green leaves
No lesions or discoloration
Normal plant growth

potato.importance: Major vegetable crop, especially in UP, Bihar, West Bengal

diseases.name: Potato Late Blight
symptoms: Water-soaked dark green to brown lesions on leaves
White fluffy spore masses on leaf undersides in humid weather
Lesions spread rapidly and kill the entire plant
Brown rot inside potato tubers
Foul smell from infected tubers
treatments: Preventive spray every 7-10 days in cool humid weather

diseases.name: Potato Early Blight
symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings on older leaves
Yellow halo around spots
Premature defoliation

diseases.name: Healthy
symptoms: Green leaves
Vigorous growth
No lesions

cotton.importance: Major cash crop — India is world's largest producer

diseases.name: Cotton Leaf Curl Disease
diseases.pathogen: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuV) — whitefly transmitted
symptoms: Upward curling of leaves
Vein thickening and leaf enations (outgrowths on undersurface)
Stunted plant growth
Leaf cup-shaped appearance
Severe reduction in boll formation
treatments: Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.3 ml/liter for whitefly control
No cure for viral infection — manage vector
prevention: Whitefly monitoring and control from early stages

diseases.name: Cotton Bacterial Blight
symptoms: Angular water-soaked spots on leaves limited by veins
Spots turn dark brown to black
Defoliation in severe cases
Blackening of bolls

diseases.name: Healthy
symptoms: Green leaves
Normal boll development

maize.importance: Third most important cereal crop in India

diseases.name: Maize Northern Leaf Blight
symptoms: Long elliptical gray-green to tan lesions on leaves
Lesions 2.5 to 15 cm long
Lesions parallel to leaf edges
Dark fungal sporulation visible on lesions
Lower leaves affected first, moving upward

diseases.name: Maize Gray Leaf Spot
symptoms: Small rectangular gray to tan lesions
Lesions run parallel to leaf veins
Grayish powdery appearance due to sporulation

diseases.name: Fall Armyworm
symptoms: Ragged holes in leaves from larval feeding
Frass (greenish feces) visible in leaf whorls
Damaged leaf whorl with characteristic 'window-pane' feeding pattern
Papery transparent appearance of damaged young leaves

diseases.name: Healthy
symptoms: Green leaves
Normal growth

sugarcane.importance: Major cash crop — India is second largest producer

diseases.name: Red Rot
symptoms: Drying of leaves starting from leaf tip
Red discoloration inside stalk with white patches
Sour smell from affected stalk
Wilting and death of top leaves
prevention: Hot water treatment of setts at 50°C for 2 hours

diseases.name: Wilt
symptoms: Yellowing and drying of leaves starting from lower leaves
Internal stalk shows yellow to red discoloration
Shriveling of stalks

groundnut.importance: Major oilseed crop — India is second largest producer

diseases.name: Early Leaf Spot
symptoms: Small circular yellowish spots on upper leaf surface
Spots turn dark brown to black
Yellow halo visible around spots
Premature defoliation

diseases.name: Tikka Disease
symptoms: Dark brown to black spots, larger than early leaf spot
No yellow halo (unlike early leaf spot)
Spots appear on both upper and lower leaf surfaces
Gray sporulation on underside of spots

mustard.importance: Major Rabi oilseed crop in India

diseases.name: Alternaria Blight
symptoms: Circular dark brown to black spots with concentric rings
Spots on leaves, stems, and pods
Yellow halo in early stages
Premature dropping of leaves

diseases.name: White Rust
symptoms: White blister-like pustules on lower leaf surface
Chlorotic (yellow) spots on upper surface corresponding to pustules
Distortion and twisting of shoots and flower heads (staghead)

chilli.importance: Important spice and vegetable crop in India

diseases.name: Chilli Anthracnose
symptoms: Sunken circular spots on fruits — starts at tip
Dark brown to black spots with concentric rings on fruits
Pink to orange spore masses in humid conditions
Die-back of twigs from tip
prevention: Remove and destroy infected fruits and twigs

diseases.name: Chilli Leaf Curl Virus
diseases.pathogen: Chilli Leaf Curl Virus (ChiLCV) — whitefly transmitted
symptoms: Curling and crinkling of young leaves
Stunted plant growth
Mosaic pattern on leaves
Reduced fruit set

diseases.name: Powdery Mildew
symptoms: White powdery growth on upper leaf surface
Yellowing of leaves
Premature leaf drop

onion.importance: Most widely consumed vegetable crop in India

diseases.name: Purple Blotch
symptoms: Small white lesions with purple center on leaves
Lesions enlarge to elliptical shape with purple-brown color
Yellow border around lesions
Leaves collapse from tip

diseases.name: Stemphylium Blight
symptoms: Small water-soaked yellowish spots that turn light tan
Spots with dark brown border
Leaves die from tip

soybean.importance: Major protein crop in central India (MP, Maharashtra)

diseases.name: Soybean Bacterial Pustule
symptoms: Small pale green spots with raised center (pustules) on leaves
Yellow halo around pustules
Premature defoliation in severe cases

diseases.name: Soybean Rust
symptoms: Small tan to gray lesions on lower leaf surface
Tan to reddish-brown pustules visible on underside
Lesions enlarge and turn dark brown
Premature defoliation

grape.importance: Important horticultural crop in Maharashtra, Karnataka

diseases.name: Grape Powdery Mildew
symptoms: White powdery patches on leaves, shoots, and berries
Leaves show chlorosis beneath powdery patches
Berries crack and shrivel when infected young

diseases.name: Grape Downy Mildew
symptoms: Yellow oily spots on upper leaf surface
White cottony spore masses on underside of leaves
Affected berries turn brown and mummify
Shoot distortion

diseases.name: Healthy
symptoms: Green shiny leaves
Firm bunches

banana.importance: Most popular fruit crop in India

diseases.name: Panama Wilt
symptoms: Yellowing of lower leaves starting from margins
Wilting and collapse of leaves
Brown discoloration of pseudostem when cut
Plant death without recovery
treatments: Drench with Carbendazim @ 2g/liter around healthy plants

diseases.name: Sigatoka Leaf Spot
symptoms: Pale yellowish streaks on young leaves
Streaks turn brown with gray center
Leaves die prematurely
Premature ripening of bunch
